player_actions: Delegates medically necessary stabilizing intervention to escorted Tiyo, explicitly assumes responsibility for authorizing her assistance (does not adjudicate her guilt or give her legal immunity).
Pursues masked river shinobi with Shunshin, tries to immobilize alive, brings subdued enemy back to checkpoint. No other player-directed action or speech.

chronology.actor: Tiyo, local border medic, guarding Kusa officer
chronology.visible: Tiyo chooses to save patient's life, bypasses damaged external gas coupler with spare oxygen bottle and verified gas line, without shutting or changing unnamed IV pump. Saturation briefly reads 91%, improves to 94% after oxygen feed restoration. Patient conscious; Tiyo and local medic note supplemental oxygen alone does not guarantee adequate ventilation given respiratory muscle weakness, requires equipped transport and monitoring. No full cure.

Shiki activates another Shunshin Nulevaya Stupen to pursue enemy ~33m across muddy route amid smoke and willow river roots; physical movement requires deceleration/last steps once visibility impaired, not instant teleport. Enemy wounded left shoulder prepares one-legged push/dive into river, reacts too late to Shiki speed, withdraws kunai with right hand, stabs low to stop pursuit. Shiki closes using declared immobilization objective, deflects/controls weapon arm; enemy loses kunai and tries to drop into water. Shiki keeps him grounded, contacts with chakra scalpel causing right-hand motor conduction impairment, restrains arms with field ninja wire, also binds legs to prevent immediate escape. Enemy remains alive and breathing, distressed, earlier left shoulder bruised and right hand function impaired, no successful escape. Player did not authorize killing or torture; no further speech assigned to Shiki.

Enemy looks at Shiki's emotionally unreadable face after speed encounter, shocked and afraid but not magically compelled. Says 'Кто… ты такой?' and 'Нам говорили… один дзёнин. Один. Не говорили, что такой.' This is enemy's firsthand speech, evidence he was briefed about one jonin but no established source or employer. Shiki conveys secured enemy to Kusa border station ~50m, without deciding to question or execute.

Shiki brings captured masked male alive, local Kusa guard unsettled by brief chase and quick capture. Jun with right chest impact bruise orders both captured attackers checked for explosive tags/poisons/communications, under guard. Kunoichi remains awake quadriparetic/functional motor paralysis after previous precise arm/leg peripheral nerve injury; she says 'Чувствую. Я всё чувствую. Просто не могу пошевелить.' She needs hospital neurological assessment; no guarantee reversible damage.

Four Kusa medical shinobi arrive at Ivovy Brod with portable respiratory support and patient transfer equipment. Female team lead hears Tiyo case summary: conscious spontaneously but weakly breathing patient, reserve external oxygen feed active, O2 sat94%, unlabelled IV continuing. She requests Shiki med expertise on unknown infusion risk; does not override Shiki decision. Patient not yet moved to hospital.

While making transport room, medic discovers previously unseen false floor/secured iron hatch in THIRD wagon behind first-pass medical packing, engraved exactly M-4 / 032. Earlier initial visual inspection missed concealed hatch, no full dismantling or inspection yet. Med worker directly asks Shiki whether it should be opened. Contents unknown, label may relate to 031 series but no proof; wagon2 patient still requires care, attack aftermath ongoing. Stop for Shiki decision.
